Thought: To solve this problem, I need to understand the definitions and typical temperature order of the flash point, flame point, and auto-ignition point. The flash point is the lowest temperature at which a liquid can form an ignitable mixture in air. The flame point is slightly higher, being the temperature at which a liquid produces enough vapors to sustain combustion. The auto-ignition point is the temperature at which a substance will spontaneously ignite without an external source of ignition. Therefore, the typical order in increasing temperature is: Flash point < Flame point < Auto-ignition point.
